what_it_does: This work improves the quality of compressed scientific data by applying a small neural network as a post-processing filter. When scientific datasets are compressed using lossy techniques (which discard some data to shrink file size), visible artifacts appear in the reconstructed data. A lightweight three-dimensional convolutional neural network (CNN) cleans up these artifacts by learning from examples, making the recovered data look more like the original without slowing down computation significantly. The method works across multiple compressors and scientific domains like climate modeling or materials science.
